nodes.title: Ingress (The Listener)
nodes.action: Process 20ms PCM frames at 16kHz via lock-free ring buffers
nodes.notes: camelot-audio-dsp is now a real Rust crate: 20 ms / 16 kHz framing (320 samples), a non-blocking ring buffer with short-write drop accounting, a sample-derived audio clock that stays authoritative for viseme sync, hangover VAD, and a process-wide open-buffer gauge that makes the 'open ring buffers = 0' invariant a checkable integer. wasm-bindgen glue is compiled only for wasm32, so host tests stay toolchain-light. Reproduce with `cargo test -p camelot-audio-dsp` (20 tests + doctest) and `cargo build -p camelot-audio-dsp --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release`. The Python s26_audio_bridge remains the deployed predecessor bridge carrying the same ring-buffer/VAD semantics, but it is no longer the only artifact behind this node.
